adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is set (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`, which becomes a no-op when it is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from other hosts’ `user.destinationCalendar` values, this means those calendars can be silently dropped in the constructed `evt`.
